Here is your GMS1 filled in. The form asks for BLOCK CAPITALS, so when the values come back, check they are in capitals, and rewrite any that are not.

[B01] [✔] Ms   (leave Mr, Mrs and Miss unticked)
[B02] Surname: ESCALANTE
[B03] Date of birth: 09 AUG 1991
[B04] First names: MARICEL BUENAFLOR
[B05] NHS No.: leave blank (you have never lived in the UK, so you do not have one yet; the practice will arrange it)
[B06] Previous surname/s: leave blank or write NONE (you have never had another surname)
[B07] [✔] Female
[B08] Town and country of birth: CEBU CITY
[B09] Home address: NEEDS-YOU
[B10] Postcode: NEEDS-YOU
[B11] Telephone number: +65 8555 0143

Previous medical records
[B12] Your previous address in UK: leave blank or write NONE (never lived in the UK)
[B13] Name of previous doctor while at that address: leave blank
[B14] Address of previous doctor: leave blank

If you are from abroad
[B15] Your first UK address where registered with a GP: NEEDS-YOU (this is your first GP registration, so it is your new Leeds address, the same as B09 and B10)
[B16] If previously resident in UK, date of leaving: leave blank (not previously resident)
[B17] Date you first came to live in UK: 03/11/2026

[B18] Address before enlisting: leave blank

[B21] [ ] leave unticked (not applicable)

Dispensing
[B22] [ ] [ ] leave both unticked, unless one of them is true for your Leeds address

[B23] [✔] Signature of Patient, then sign by hand
[B24] Date: NEEDS-YOU (write the date on the day you sign)

What is missing (NEEDS-YOU)
- B09, B10 and B15: your new Leeds address and its postcode. It is not saved in mdoc, so write it in by hand. Do not use Blk 418 Bedok North Avenue 2, #07-215, Singapore 460418 here unless you have already updated it to the Leeds address; if it is still your Singapore address, it is wrong for this form. Put the postcode on its own in B10, not in B09.
- B24: the date you sign the form.

Things to check by hand
- B03: UK forms usually expect DD/MM/YYYY. 09 AUG 1991 is stored as printed in your passport, so if it comes back in another shape (for example with the month in letters), rewrite it as day/month/year.
- B04: if you have no middle name stored, BUENAFLOR will simply be empty; that is fine.
- B08: the form wants both town and country. If CEBU CITY comes back as only a town, add the country after it by hand.
- B11: if +65 8555 0143 is still your Singapore number, cross it out and write your UK mobile number instead, so the practice can reach you.

Your passport number, issue date and issuing authority are not needed on this form. The practice may ask to see your passport and visa (BRP or eVisa share code) as ID and proof of address, but that is shown in person, not written here. The organ donation section on the back was not included in what you sent, so I have not filled it.
